name: context-gardener-cowork
description: Context hygiene for Cowork and other hosted Claude surfaces, where the context that steers a session is a persistent memory store, account skills and any connected folder rather than a local .claude directory. Runs the seven context-gardener drift checks, ranks findings by how badly each could mislead, stages fixes outside the loaded surface, and writes to live memory or a skill only on your instruction. Sibling to context-gardener, for the Claude Code file surface.
